'''''Phleum''''' (common name '''timothy''') is a genus of [[annual plant|annual]] and [[perennial plant|perennial]] plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Linné |first=Carl von |url=https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/358078#page/71/mode/1up |title=Caroli Linnaei ... Species plantarum :exhibentes plantas rite cognitas, ad genera relatas, cum differentiis specificis, nominibus trivialibus, synonymis selectis, locis natalibus, secundum systema sexuale digestas... |last2=Linné |first2=Carl von |last3=Salvius |first3=Lars |date=1753 |publisher=Impensis Laurentii Salvii |volume=1 |location=Holmiae}}</ref> The genus is native to [[Europe]], [[Asia]] and north [[Africa]], with one species (''P. alpinum'') also in [[North America|North]] and [[South America]].<ref>{{Cite web |date= |title=Species in GRIN for genus |url=http://www.ars-grin.gov/cgi-bin/npgs/html/splist.pl?9257 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081011203441/http://www.ars-grin.gov/cgi-bin/npgs/html/splist.pl?9257 |archive-date=2008-10-11 |access-date= |website=www.ars-grin.gov}}</ref>

They are tufted grasses growing to 20–150 cm tall, with cylindrical, spike-like panicles containing many densely packed spikelets.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=125044|title=Phleum in Flora of China @ efloras.org|website=www.efloras.org|access-date=2018-10-15}}</ref>

Numerous species now considered better suited to other genera: ''[[Aegilops]], [[Alopecurus]], [[Beckmannia]], [[Crypsis (genus)|Crypsis]], [[Cynodon]], [[Cynosurus]], [[Digitaria]], [[Elytrophorus]], [[Ischaemum]], [[Mnesithea]], [[Muhlenbergia]], [[Pennisetum]], [[Pentameris]], [[Phalaris (plant)|Phalaris]], [[Polypogon]], [[Polytrias]], [[Sesleria]], [[Tribolium (plant)|Tribolium]]''

==Cultivation and uses==
Several species are important for [[cattle]] feed and as [[hay]] for [[horse]]s and other domestic animals.<ref>{{Cite PLANTS|symbol=PHLEU|taxon=Phleum|access-date=2018-10-15}}</ref>
